material_findings.title: D2 federal-directory metadata now exposes a start-date discrepancy that should remain provenance-visible
material_findings.summary: USA.gov's D2 listing, updated Sep. 15, gives a Sep. 15 federal-directory start date and Mar. 1, 2027 end date with $1M total prizes. DARPA primary materials used in the Sep. 16 morning contribution describe rolling qualification activity beginning Sep. 11. This is a source-metadata discrepancy, not evidence that the opportunity changed twice. DARPA primary rules should control participation mechanics while the USA.gov value remains preserved as directory provenance.
